description: Dataset for Evaluating Costs and Operations of Public Bus Fleet Electrification is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Hubert Maximilian Sistig, Philipp Sinhuber. Supplementary material for the paper "Evaluating Costs and Operations of Public Bus Fleet Electrification". The following data is included: 01) Detailed statistics on the transport operators included in the processed GTFS data from DELFI and the Mobility Database 02) Data on routes, trips, itineraries, stops and possible deadhead trips for the selected transport operators 03) ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 267312231 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
